snippet.title: The Starship Simulator You've Been Waiting For
snippet.description:
Welcome to your mission briefing on Starship Command: Orion Spur. This comprehensive overview breaks down everything you need to know about SCOS - what makes it different from every other space game, why we’re building it, and why it deserves your support. Get the full strategic picture of our unique dual-command system that lets you lead from the bridge OR take direct control of your destroyer, meet the authentic bridge crew that executes your orders, and understand the tactical depth that makes every combat decision matter. Whether you’re a longtime sci-fi fan waiting for the ultimate command experience or discovering SCOS for the first time, this briefing gives you everything you need to understand why this is the starship simulator you’ve been waiting for. The CSV Leonidas is waiting… are you ready to take command?
